parsed.memo: When a prior project succeeded under a weighting that favored exploration over commitment (e.g., 8:1), treat that success as evidence for the old objective, not as a permanent constraint on future weightings. Retain the prior commitment only as a provisional default: it remains useful until later tasks explicitly authenticate a revised weighting or supply contradictory evidence. On such revision, update the weights and re-evaluate commitments accordingly, preserving the prior rule as a fallback rather than an overriding authority.
